title: Chat header sizing scoped to chat panel + availability time range update

requirements.summary: Adjust chat message header to use a 25x25 avatar and 14px display name only within the chat message list, leaving all other avatar/name sizing unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In the chat message list (frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.tsx), each message renders the sender avatar at exactly 25x25 pixels.
In the chat message list, the sender display name renders at 14px font size.
Avatar/name sizing in other areas that use AvatarName (e.g., day detail page and any other pages/components) remains unchanged from current behavior.

file_operations.description: Add optional, backwards-compatible style override props (e.g., avatarClassName and nameClassName) so callers can request specific avatar and display-name sizing without changing existing default size behavior elsewhere.
Update chat message header rendering to pass AvatarName override props to enforce an exact 25x25 avatar and 14px display name for chat messages only (keep other AvatarName usages unchanged).

requirements.summary: Restrict availability start-time dropdown options to 8:00 AM through 9:00 PM inclusive, while preserving and labeling any existing legacy time value outside the range.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Add/Edit Availability page (frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.tsx), the selectable TIME_OPTIONS start at "8:00 AM" and end at "9:00 PM".
Times earlier than 8:00 AM and later than 9:00 PM are not shown as normal dropdown options.
If an existing availability has a legacy time value outside the new range, that value still appears as a selectable "(legacy)" option, and the form can be saved without losing it.

file_operations.description: Update TIME_OPTIONS to include only 8:00 AM through 9:00 PM (inclusive) and keep the existing legacy-value insertion behavior so out-of-range stored times remain selectable and saveable with a "(legacy)" label.
